lead.headline: Still nothing to set; Kamara gains a role, not a slot
lead.deck: Wilson OUT, Wentz official for Monday; Allen cleared; Miller's release lifts Kamara to 12.3, 0.9 behind Allgeier.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson is out at Kansas City with the concussion, and Minnesota's Saturday report made it official that Carson Wentz throws to Justin Jefferson on Monday — known since Thursday, so ESPN's 18.4 already knows. Saturday's reports were otherwise kind: Buffalo cleared Josh Allen and Dalton Kincaid, Minnesota ruled out receiver Jauan Jennings, and no Sunday starter drew a designation. The afternoon's real news was in New Orleans: the Saints waived Kendre Miller, leaving Alvin Kamara the lead back. ESPN moved him to 12.3, 0.9 behind Tyler Allgeier for the FLEX — a coin flip that stays with the projection. Denzel Boston was cut healthy by Bok-aneers and is on waivers until Wednesday 02:00; that is Tuesday's decision. AVIATO lead 8.9 to 5.58, ESPN 48-52; nothing to set.
